nonblocking_findings.title: Reviewed digest not independently recomputed
nonblocking_findings.finding: This review used file reads only; no hashing tool was exercised, so the caller-supplied SHA256 79788286… was not recomputed from bytes. The prior review carried the same limit against a different digest and an r3 header; this artifact self-identifies as r4, which is consistent with a superseding revision but does not substitute for byte verification.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Recompute the digest at the point of user approval and record it alongside the r4 marker in the approval trail.

nonblocking_findings.title: Preservation manifest is category-enumerated rather than whole-tree; a write under the user Claude root outside the named categories and transaction paths remains undetected
nonblocking_findings.section: Live pilot preservation and recovery receipt; Approval and phase boundaries, row B Exit ('no unrelated mutation'); Acceptance criteria bullet 5
nonblocking_findings.finding: The manifest covers user rules, settings, hook configuration, plugin configuration and identities, credentials and transaction paths. This closes the concrete B-13 channel — the protected surfaces named in acceptance bullet 5 that the pilot could plausibly clobber — and the 'incomplete manifest fails the pilot' clause supplies a completeness duty. It is narrower than a full pre/post walk of the live user Claude tree, so the row-B exit phrase 'no unrelated mutation' is still stated more broadly than the evidence method establishes. Acceptance bullet 5 also names roles and controls, which lie outside the Phase B mutation surface entirely and outside manifest coverage.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Either capture the manifest over the full user Claude tree (metadata and digests only, credential contents excluded as already specified), or restate the row-B exit as 'no mutation outside the declared expected-diff set across the manifested protected categories', and note that roles and controls are preserved by non-inclusion in the Phase B surface rather than by manifest.

nonblocking_findings.title: Provider side-effect path set is not required to be declared before the first mutation, admitting a post-hoc allowlist
nonblocking_findings.section: Live pilot preservation and recovery receipt ('Native transcript/cache/log writes will be separately identified as expected provider side effects with exact paths')
nonblocking_findings.finding: The exemption is correctly fenced — it cannot cover settings, plugins, hooks or credentials, and unexplained differences fail the pilot. The plan does not state when the exact side-effect paths are declared. If enumerated after observing the post-manifest diff, the category becomes an explain-away channel for whatever appeared, which is the weaker of the two readings the text allows.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Require the provider side-effect path set to be declared in the pre-manifest, before the first mutation, and treat any side-effect path not present in that prior declaration as an unexplained difference.

nonblocking_findings.title: Control-flow pseudocode is not updated with the manifest capture and compare steps, while step 3 elevates that pseudocode to governing execution order
nonblocking_findings.section: Control flow pseudocode; Proposed implementation sequence step 3 ('The control-flow gate ordering will govern execution'); Live pilot preservation and recovery receipt
nonblocking_findings.finding: r4 resolves the r3 ordering conflict by making the pseudocode gate ordering authoritative, which is the correct fix. The pseudocode still shows only inventory, prestate, capability/suppressor gates, install, canary, retire and readback — no pre/post manifest capture or compare. The prose places the manifests precisely ('immediately around each live trial, negative parking operation, and final readback'), so the intent is unambiguous, but the artifact now has one location declared authoritative for ordering and a second location carrying a gate the authoritative one omits.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Add capture_protected_manifest(pre) before the first mutation, and compare_protected_manifest(post) as a failure branch into compare_and_swap_rollback, to the pseudocode so the governing control flow and the receipt section agree.

nonblocking_findings.title: Denied-read events are made invalidating but are not required to be recorded in the receipt
nonblocking_findings.finding: The r3 remediation asked for both invalidation and receipt recording of denied-read attempts. The plan adopts the stronger control (invalidation of the positive trial) but does not require the denial event, its path and its timestamp to appear in the trial receipt. Without the record, a reviewer of the receipt cannot distinguish a trial in which no denial occurred from one in which a denial occurred and the invalidation rule was applied incorrectly.
nonblocking_findings.remediation: Require every tool-layer denial during a lazy-discovery trial to be recorded in that trial's receipt with path and time, alongside the resulting invalidation disposition.
